style: Realistic candid photograph shot on a modern mirrorless camera, natural skin texture, true-to-life colours, no text, no watermark, no logos.

items.prompt: Half-body portrait of a young East Asian woman in a linen shirt standing in a city park at golden hour, soft warm backlight on her hair, shallow depth of field, she smiles gently at the camera.
An elderly man with grey hair and glasses sits by a large window reading a newspaper, soft side window light, warm wooden interior, relaxed expression.
A laughing five-year-old boy runs toward the camera on a sandy beach, late afternoon sun, sea and sky behind him, slightly windswept hair.
Portrait of a man with short beard standing against the setting sun, strong rim light around his silhouette, lens flare, face still readable, orange sky.
High-key studio portrait of a woman in a white blouse against a pure white seamless background, bright even lighting, white background completely blown to white, face correctly exposed.
A woman in a dim restaurant lit only by a candle on the table, warm low light, dark background, slight visible grain, she looks at the camera.
Teenager in a red ski jacket on a snow-covered slope at noon, bright white snow everywhere, blue sky, goggles pushed up on the forehead.
Street portrait of a young man at night in a Tokyo alley lit by neon signs, magenta and cyan light on his face, wet pavement reflections.
Woman in a straw hat under harsh midday sun in a vineyard, hard shadows across her face, squinting slightly, strong contrast.
Man holding a clear umbrella in light rain on a city street, raindrops visible, overcast grey light, cool tones.
Close-up of a baby lying on a white blanket looking up curiously, soft diffused window light, pastel colours.
Woman seen through a cafe window holding a coffee cup, reflections of the street in the glass, warm interior light, candid moment.
Alpine lake at sunrise with mirror-still water reflecting snow-capped peaks, pink and orange clouds, pine trees along the shore.
Wide beach at sunset, long shadows, gentle waves, the sun just above the horizon, warm saturated sky.
Flat snow-covered field under a clear midday sky, nearly all white with a single bare tree and a wooden fence, very bright scene.
Foggy pine forest in the early morning, low contrast, soft grey light, a narrow trail disappearing into the mist.
City skyline at night across a river, lit skyscrapers reflected in the water, long exposure look with smooth water, deep blue sky.
Sand dunes in late afternoon light, crisp ridge lines, deep shadows on one side, a lone hiker far away for scale.
Green rice terraces on a hillside after rain, overcast soft light, water in the paddies reflecting the sky.
Tall waterfall in a mossy gorge, silky long-exposure water, wet rocks, lush green vegetation.
Overcast grey sea and sky with a distant lighthouse, muted colours, flat light, slight drizzle.
Straight country road through an autumn forest, red and yellow leaves, dappled sunlight, leading lines to the vanishing point.
Path lined with hundreds of vermilion torii gates at Fushimi Inari, Kyoto, soft shade, no people visible.
Milky Way over a mountain ridge at night, star-filled sky, faint light pollution on the horizon, visible high-ISO grain.
Family of four (parents and two children) around a dinner table at home, all looking at the camera and smiling, warm indoor lighting, dishes on the table.
Six friends in hiking gear posing together on a mountain summit, arms around each other, bright sunny day, valley far below.
Bride and groom with four bridesmaids and groomsmen on a lawn in front of a garden, formal group pose, soft overcast light.
Two young women taking a selfie-style photo at arm's length in front of a Ferris wheel, both grinning, close to the camera, wide angle.
Three children aged five to nine playing with a garden hose in a backyard, water droplets in the air, afternoon sun, laughing.
Five friends gathered around a birthday cake with lit candles in a dim living room, faces lit by candlelight, one person about to blow out the candles.
Seven colleagues standing in a bright modern office, casual business clothes, mixed ages and ethnicities, friendly smiles.
Grandfather, grandmother and a toddler grandchild on a park bench, the toddler holding a balloon, warm evening light.
Four friends posing for a photo at a cafe table; three smile at the camera while the person on the left has both eyes closed mid-blink.
Five family members posing in front of a temple gate; four look at the camera while the teenage boy on the right looks away at his phone.
Group of four at a picnic on the grass; three sit still and sharp while the child in front is moving and motion-blurred.
Eight people of mixed ages arranged on the stone steps of an old building, formal group photo, even overcast light, every face visible.
A young woman in a yellow dress jumping in the air on a beach at sunset, arms raised, same framing and position.

variants.delta: She is mid-jump, eyes open, big smile, perfectly sharp.
She is mid-jump with both eyes closed.
She is landing, her body and the dress are motion-blurred.
The sky and sand are heavily overexposed, washed-out highlights.

items.prompt: A seven-year-old girl leaning over a birthday cake with candles in a dim dining room, family hands visible at the edges.

variants.delta: She looks at the camera, eyes open, smiling, sharp.
She blows the candles with her eyes squeezed shut and cheeks puffed.
Her face is out of focus, the cake is sharp.
The image is very dark and underexposed, only the candle flames bright.

items.prompt: A man in a blue t-shirt throwing a frisbee in a park, dog waiting behind him, bright afternoon.

variants.delta: Frozen at the release, sharp, eyes open looking at the frisbee.
His arm is motion-blurred, body slightly blurred.
He has turned his head away from the camera.
The whole frame is slightly blurred by camera shake.

items.prompt: A couple walking hand in hand through a tunnel of vermilion torii gates in Kyoto, seen from behind at three-quarter angle.

variants.delta: Both turn their faces toward the camera and smile, sharp.
Both look straight ahead, faces not visible.
A stranger walks into the frame on the left, partially blocking the couple.
The woman's eyes are closed as she turns toward the camera.

items.prompt: Four friends raising wine glasses in a toast at a restaurant table, warm tungsten light.

variants.delta: Everyone looks at the camera with open eyes and smiles, sharp.
The woman on the right has her eyes closed.
The glasses and hands are motion-blurred as they clink.
Heavy flash: faces overexposed and flat, background black.

items.prompt: A golden retriever running toward the camera on a grassy field with its owner, a woman in a grey hoodie, jogging behind.

variants.delta: The dog is sharp and in focus, ears flying, the owner smiling.
The dog is motion-blurred, the owner sharp.
The dog is much closer and partially out of the frame.
The owner's eyes are closed and she is looking down.

items.prompt: A girl of about six on a playground swing at the top of her arc, dappled sunlight under trees.

variants.delta: She looks at the camera laughing, eyes open, sharp.
She is motion-blurred swinging through the frame.
Her eyes are closed and her hair covers half her face.
Strong backlight makes her face dark and underexposed.

items.prompt: A street guitarist in a flat cap performing on a cobblestone square, small crowd blurred in the background.

variants.delta: He looks up at the camera, eyes open, singing, sharp.
His eyes are closed as he sings.
His strumming hand is motion-blurred, the face sharp.
Two tourists walk through the foreground partly blocking him.

items.prompt: A woman in a red coat standing in a park, the entire image badly out of focus, everything soft and blurry.
A man sitting on a sofa in a living room, the photo severely underexposed, almost black with only faint details.
Children on a beach, the photo severely overexposed, washed out, sky and sand pure white, faces nearly lost.
Friends at a dim bar, extremely high ISO photo with heavy colour noise and grain, muddy shadows.
Harbour with sailboats and a horizon tilted about 8 degrees clockwise, otherwise sharp and well exposed.
Portrait of a man outdoors shooting into the sun with heavy lens flare and haze, very low contrast, milky image.
